verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an official MCP server at docs.rollbar.com/docs/mcp-server-setup. It implements the stdio server type, so AI tools such as Claude and Cursor run it directly, and a probe confirmed the page exists. This applies to an error-tracking SaaS, not an agent itself. missing for 10: details of the tools/data exposed via MCP, a remote/hosted MCP endpoint option, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.
